state:
Goal `core-router-and-4-more`, stage 2 (feature proofs). `Core\Router::match`, `::methodsFor` and `::url` have every feature proof on disk: about, three examples, an attack, a bench, and a Rust `covers:` test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs`'s test module. `Core\Router` has its class card.

The `url` attack found that a capture value of `.` or `..`, or a rest capture with one between its `/`s, built a link a browser resolves outside its route (`/docs/../admin` is `/admin`). `substitute` now throws for one through `stays_in_its_segment`, so `urlAbsolute` and `urlSigned` throw for it too; `tests/conformance/core/router-url-refuses-a-dot-segment-that-would-leave-its-route.nvst` pins it.

Still owing examples, hostile, perf and tests: `urlAbsolute`, `urlSigned`, `signedRoute`. All five `Core\Router\Match` members owe examples, help, hostile, perf and tests. `Core\Script`, `Core\Script\ExitReport` and `Core\Secret` are not started.

next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs` and the `Core/Router` trees under `docs/examples/`, `tests/hostile/` and `benches/members/`.

items.text: **`Core\Router::urlAbsolute`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). It needs a configured `[[app]] origin`; `tests/conformance/core/router-url-absolute-is-url-with-the-configured-origin-in-front.nvst` shows how a case sets one, and an example may need the same. Its card at `URL_ABSOLUTE_DOC` wants a plain rewrite, and the Rust test can reuse `prepared` and `text_params` beside `url_substitutes_each_capture_and_writes_the_keys_left_over_as_the_query`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:1077`

**`Core\Router::urlSigned`** — same owed list; `URL_SIGNED_DOC` wants a plain rewrite, and `url_signed_launders_for_the_url_path_sink_exactly_as_url_does` already drives it without a `covers:` marker. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:364`

**`Core\Router::signedRoute`** — same owed list. It reads the request the door matched, so its examples may need a `.nvsr` request; the `shop()` table beside the `signedRoute` Rust tests is the fixture. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:2659`

backlog: `Core\Router\Match`'s five members and its class card — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs` (`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`).
`docs/rules/routing/link-name-and-params-are-checked.md` says the result is safe as a path but does not name the dot-segment throw that makes it so; one sentence there would state it.
Any change to `router.rs` makes every Router bench stale: re-record with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Router'` before the dossier check.
